# Synthetic codec fixtures

These access units are generated by this repository's `generate.py`; no third-party media is included.
FFmpeg/ffprobe are offline fixture-generation tools, not a library dependency or decoder fallback.
The checked-in files were generated with FFmpeg n4.1.3-381-gaf5fb5afd4, its native AAC encoder, and libx264.
Regeneration with other encoder versions can produce different valid compressed bytes.

- `aac.config`: AAC-LC AudioSpecificConfig, 48 kHz stereo, 1024 samples per access unit.
- `aac-*.bin`: 13 raw access units containing a generated 440 Hz sine wave, including encoder delay/padding.
  Decoder tests expect all 13 × 1024 samples. Container trim metadata is deliberately not applied or invented.
- `avc.config`: AVCDecoderConfigurationRecord for a generated 64×48, 24 fps test pattern, Main profile.
- `avc-*.bin`: 24 length-prefixed access units in decode order, including two B frames between reference frames.
- `aac.txt` / `avc.txt`: `filename pts dts duration timescale key_frame`, with integer timestamps.

Run `python3 tests/fixtures/codec/generate.py` with FFmpeg and ffprobe on PATH to regenerate.
The generator extracts packet boundaries from its temporary MP4 files. No container parser is included in Lib-Media.
